ruleDefinitions.name: CreateDump Process Dump
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects uses of the createdump.exe LOLOBIN utility to dump process memory

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\createdump\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "FX\_VER\_INTERNALNAME\_STR") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-u\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-full\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-f\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-\\-name\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.dmp\\ .*")))
